sources.title: 404 Media 起底 Proton 内部 AI 转型之争：CEO Andy Yen 强推 AI 引发恐惧文化 / Manifestos, Fear, and ‘Loser Thinking’: Inside Proton’s AI Reckoning
sources.title_zh: 404 Media 起底 Proton 内部 AI 转型之争：CEO Andy Yen 强推 AI 引发恐惧文化
sources.title_en: Manifestos, Fear, and ‘Loser Thinking’: Inside Proton’s AI Reckoning
sources.title_original: Manifestos, Fear, and ‘Loser Thinking’: Inside Proton’s AI Reckoning
sources.summary: 404 Media 采访九名现任与离职 Proton 员工并查阅内部文件，报道 CEO Andy Yen 强推 AI 转型引发的内部冲突。10 月公司 90% 代码由 AI 编写，多使用 Anthropic 的 Claude；Yen 称今年是最后一年招聘工程师，并宣布将以可能决定去留的重新面试评估员工 AI 使用情况。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 404 Media采访Proton 8名在职和1名前员工并查阅Slack记录，披露CEO Andy Yen内部强推AI，斥责要求先pentest的工程师为loser thinking，还以AI使用情况重审员工去留。

en.summary: 404 Media interviewed nine current and former Proton employees and reviewed internal documents, reporting on internal conflict sparked by CEO Andy Yen’s aggressive push for an AI transformation. In October, 90% of the company’s code was written by AI, mostly using Anthropic’s Claude; Yen said this year would be the last year Proton hires engineers and announced re-interviews to assess employees’ AI usage that could determine whether they stay.
en.reason: Proton CEO Andy Yen pushed an AI overhaul with 90% of October code written largely via Anthropic’s Claude, called pentest-seeking engineers “loser thinking,” and tied re-interviews to AI use and jobs, per 404 Media.

stories.title: Google 与 Reddit 同日股价大跌，AI 搜索变现困境冲击开放网络 / What Google and Reddit's bad days have in common

sources.title: Google 与 Reddit 同日股价大跌，AI 搜索变现困境冲击开放网络 / What Google and Reddit's bad days have in common
sources.title_zh: Google 与 Reddit 同日股价大跌，AI 搜索变现困境冲击开放网络
sources.title_en: What Google and Reddit's bad days have in common
sources.title_original: What Google and Reddit's bad days have in common
sources.summary: Casey Newton 分析 Google 与 Reddit 同日遭遇的股市重挫：Alphabet 股价跌 12.6%，蒸发约 $5000 亿市值，为史上第二大单日市值缩水；高管承认 AI Mode 变现能力低于传统搜索，尽管 AI Mode 月用户约 10 亿、搜索收入仍增长 12% 至 $633.5 亿。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Alphabet单日跌12.6%、市值蒸发约5000亿美元，Reddit跌15%且搜索流量下滑，原文借此说明Google的AI Mode比传统搜索更不赚钱。

en.summary: Casey Newton analyzes the same-day stock market rout that hit Google and Reddit: Alphabet shares fell 12.6%, wiping out roughly $500 billion in market value—the second-largest single-day market cap loss in history. Executives acknowledged that AI Mode monetizes worse than traditional search, even though AI Mode has about 1 billion monthly users and search revenue still grew 12% to $63.35 billion.
en.reason: Alphabet fell 12.6%, shedding $500 billion—the second-largest single-day loss ever—and Reddit dropped 15% as executives conceded AI Mode, with roughly 1 billion monthly users, monetizes worse than traditional search despite search revenue rising 12% to $63.35 billion.

stories.title: Google 市值蒸发 5000 亿美元，AI 概要冲击搜索广告引发华尔街担忧 / Google value plunges by $500B as AI fears rattle Wall Street

sources.title: Google 市值蒸发 5000 亿美元，AI 概要冲击搜索广告引发华尔街担忧 / Google value plunges by $500B as AI fears rattle Wall Street
sources.title_zh: Google 市值蒸发 5000 亿美元，AI 概要冲击搜索广告引发华尔街担忧
sources.title_en: Google value plunges by $500B as AI fears rattle Wall Street
sources.title_original: Google value plunges by $500B as AI fears rattle Wall Street
sources.summary: Alphabet 因 AI 搜索概要影响广告收入，单日市值从 3.97 万亿跌至 3.46 万亿美元，缩水超 5000 亿美元。该季度总营收增 25% 至 1276 亿美元，云业务营收增 103% 至近 310 亿美元，但利润下降 25%，自由现金流为负超 90 亿美元。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Alphabet因AI搜索摘要影响广告收入，周四市值蒸发超5000亿美元、股价跌近13%；营收1276亿美元增25%，利润降25%，自由现金流负超90亿美元。

en.summary: Alphabet’s market cap fell from $3.97 trillion to $3.46 trillion in a single day, a loss of more than $500 billion, as AI search summaries weighed on ad revenue. For the quarter, total revenue rose 25% to $127.6 billion and cloud revenue grew 103% to nearly $31 billion, but profit fell 25% and free cash flow was negative at over $9 billion.
en.reason: Alphabet lost over $500 billion in market value in a day as AI search summaries pressured ad revenue, with quarterly revenue up 25% to $127.6 billion but profit down 25% and free cash flow negative above $9 billion.

primary_item.title: Google 市值蒸发 5000 亿美元，AI 概要冲击搜索广告引发华尔街担忧 / Google value plunges by $500B as AI fears rattle Wall Street
primary_item.title_zh: Google 市值蒸发 5000 亿美元，AI 概要冲击搜索广告引发华尔街担忧
primary_item.title_en: Google value plunges by $500B as AI fears rattle Wall Street
primary_item.title_original: Google value plunges by $500B as AI fears rattle Wall Street
primary_item.summary: Alphabet 因 AI 搜索概要影响广告收入，单日市值从 3.97 万亿跌至 3.46 万亿美元，缩水超 5000 亿美元。该季度总营收增 25% 至 1276 亿美元，云业务营收增 103% 至近 310 亿美元，但利润下降 25%，自由现金流为负超 90 亿美元。
primary_item.recommend_reason_zh: Alphabet因AI搜索摘要影响广告收入，周四市值蒸发超5000亿美元、股价跌近13%；营收1276亿美元增25%，利润降25%，自由现金流负超90亿美元。

en.summary: Alphabet’s market cap fell from $3.97 trillion to $3.46 trillion in a single day, a loss of more than $500 billion, as AI search summaries weighed on ad revenue. For the quarter, total revenue rose 25% to $127.6 billion and cloud revenue grew 103% to nearly $31 billion, but profit fell 25% and free cash flow was negative at over $9 billion.
en.reason: Alphabet lost over $500 billion in market value in a day as AI search summaries pressured ad revenue, with quarterly revenue up 25% to $127.6 billion but profit down 25% and free cash flow negative above $9 billion.

en.summary: On Amazon’s earnings call, CEO Andy Jassy reiterated that AWS can become a trillion-dollar annual revenue business within five to ten years. Amazon shares fell about 6% in after-hours trading following the report.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Google 10月27日发布 Sleep Framework，其论文 Language Models Need Sleep 提出让大模型在睡眠阶段借助参数扩展、专家混合记忆块与知识蒸馏巩固记忆，避免边学边忘。

en.title: AI learns to "sleep": Google takes aim at large models' chronic habit of forgetting what they learn
en.reason: Google released Sleep Framework on October 27 with its paper Language Models Need Sleep, proposing sleep-phase parameter expansion, mixture-of-experts memory blocks and knowledge distillation so large models consolidate new knowledge instead of forgetting it.

stories.title: Anthropic S-1 文件解读：财务表现强劲但增长放缓存隐忧 / Anthropic’s financials are surprisingly strong

sources.title: Anthropic S-1 文件解读：财务表现强劲但增长放缓存隐忧 / Anthropic’s financials are surprisingly strong
sources.title_zh: Anthropic S-1 文件解读：财务表现强劲但增长放缓存隐忧
sources.title_en: Anthropic’s financials are surprisingly strong
sources.title_original: Anthropic’s financials are surprisingly strong
sources.summary: 作者通读 Anthropic 公开版 S-1 文件，认为公司财务状况好于预期：2026 年第二季度收入从一季度的 47 亿美元增至 116 亿美元，并录得首个运营利润，截至 6 月底现金储备仅次于 Google 和 Berkshire Hathaway。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 作者读完Anthropic全部421页S-1，梳理出Q1营收47亿、Q2增至116亿美元并首次实现营业利润，Q3达168亿美元但增速放缓，以及已承诺向Amazon、Google等投入数千亿美元算力的细节。

en.summary: The author read through Anthropic's public S-1 and concludes the company's financials are better than expected: Q2 2026 revenue rose to $11.6 billion from $4.7 billion in Q1, marking its first operating profit, with cash reserves at the end of June second only to Google and Berkshire Hathaway.
en.reason: Anthropic's public S-1 shows revenue rising from $4.7 billion in Q1 to $11.6 billion in Q2 2026 with a first operating profit, $16.8 billion in Q3, and hundreds of billions committed to Amazon and Google compute.

stories.title: Reddit 宣布转向以登录为主的体验，以应对 AI 搜索带来的流量下滑 / As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience

sources.title: Reddit 宣布转向以登录为主的体验，以应对 AI 搜索带来的流量下滑 / As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience
sources.title_zh: Reddit 宣布转向以登录为主的体验，以应对 AI 搜索带来的流量下滑
sources.title_en: As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience
sources.title_original: As search traffic dries up, Reddit announces it’s shifting to a logged-in experience
sources.summary: Reddit 在 Q3 财报中宣布将转向以登录为主的体验，以保护数据免受 AI 抓取并提升广告变现。10 月搜索流量平均每周减少超 100 万次引荐，Q3 全球日活为 1.303 亿，其中美国日活降至 5070 万，同比降 2%。Q3 收入同比增长 53% 至 8.95 亿美元，净利润 2.83 亿美元；该转变将先在美国以外市场测试，暂无全球上线时间表。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 这篇报道解释了 Reddit 为何在搜索流量枯竭、AI 改变人们在线找信息方式的背景下宣布转向 logged-in experience，并重新思考开放网络根基以保护受众和业务。

en.summary: Reddit announced in its Q3 earnings that it will shift to a login-first experience to protect its data from AI scraping and improve ad monetization. In October, search traffic averaged more than 1 million fewer referrals per week; Q3 global daily active users were 130.3 million, with US DAUs falling to 50.7 million, down 2% year over year. Q3 revenue rose 53% year over year to $895 million, with net income of $283 million; the shift will first be tested in markets outside the US, with no global rollout timeline yet.
en.reason: Reddit will test a logged-in experience outside the U.S. first to block AI scraping and boost ad monetization after October search referrals fell by more than 1 million weekly, even as Q3 revenue rose 53% to $895 million.

In October, search traffic averaged more than 1 million fewer referrals per week; Q3 global daily active users were 130.3 million, with US DAUs falling to 50.7 million, down 2% year over year. Q3 revenue rose 53% year over year to $895 million, with net income of $283 million; the shift will first be tested in markets outside the US, with no global rollout timeline yet.
en.reason: Reddit will test a logged-in experience outside the U.S. first to block AI scraping and boost ad monetization after October search referrals fell by more than 1 million weekly, even as Q3 revenue rose 53% to $895 million.

en.reason: Cursor says a tampered Anthropic.claude-code 2.1.313, live in its extension marketplace from 2:27am to 1:35pm PT on October 29 and installed by up to 4,100 users, plants an SSH backdoor.

stories.title: The Verge 解读 Anthropic S-1：约 8500 亿美元 compute 承诺押注递归自我改进 / Anthropic’s business plan: Build God or die trying

sources.title: The Verge 解读 Anthropic S-1：约 8500 亿美元 compute 承诺押注递归自我改进 / Anthropic’s business plan: Build God or die trying
sources.title_zh: The Verge 解读 Anthropic S-1：约 8500 亿美元 compute 承诺押注递归自我改进
sources.title_en: Anthropic’s business plan: Build God or die trying
sources.title_original: Anthropic’s business plan: Build God or die trying
sources.summary: The Verge 作者分析 Anthropic S-1，认为其商业模式依赖高速增长：2026 上半年营收同比增长 14 倍至 $16.3 billion，净收入留存率 900%，但不可撤销采购承诺合计 $265.6 billion，加上未开始的租赁协议 $321.4 billion 及其他协议，未来 20 年承诺至少约 $850 billion。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章借Anthropic的S-1拆解其商业计划：营收一年增14倍至163亿美元、调整后收入16.2亿美元，但固定成本迫使它押注Claude递归自我改进，且仅把OpenAI和Google列为对手。

en.summary: The Verge author analyzes Anthropic's S-1, arguing that its business model depends on rapid growth: H1 2026 revenue grew 14x year over year to $16.3 billion, with net revenue retention at 900%, but irrevocable purchase commitments total $265.6 billion, plus $321.4 billion in lease agreements that have not yet begun and other agreements, amounting to at least roughly $850 billion in commitments over the next 20 years.
en.reason: Anthropic’s S-1 shows 2026 H1 revenue up 14-fold to $16.3 billion against $265.6 billion in irrevocable commitments and $850 billion in 20-year obligations; The Verge argues its plan bets on Claude recursive self-improvement and names OpenAI and Google as rivals.

en.title: Kimi official tutorial: How to create 3D artwork with Kimi K3.1 Pro
en.summary: Moonshot AI (Kimi) has released an official tutorial detailing the 3D creation workflow for Kimi K3.1 Pro, covering parametric modeling and mesh modeling along with how to choose the right tools for each. The post walks through four case studies: building an Eastern heavenly palace in Unreal Engine, making a 3D-printable desk lamp, generating architecture by calling Blender purely through code, and building a miniature city with Tripo and Blender. It also shares five tips, including "show, don't tell" and blocking out a grey model before adding detail.
en.reason: Kimi's official tutorial details how Kimi K3.1 Pro handles 3D creation via parametric and mesh modeling, walking through 4 cases—an Eastern heavenly palace in Unreal Engine, a 3D-printable lamp, pure-code Blender architecture and a Tripo-plus-Blender miniature city—plus 5 tips like blocking out a grey model first.

sources.summary: OpenRouter 实测 Claude Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5.5 与 Haiku 5.5 三档模型，建议默认用 Sonnet 5.5，高频与子智能体任务用 Haiku 5.5，长且容错成本高的任务用 Opus 5.5。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Claude Opus 5.5、Sonnet 5.5和Haiku 5.5跑同样的11个编码任务，三者全过，但成本相差30倍，因此建议多数团队默认用Sonnet 5.5。

en.summary: OpenRouter tested Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, and Haiku 5.5, recommending Sonnet 5.5 as the default, Haiku 5.5 for high-frequency and sub-agent tasks, and Opus 5.5 for long tasks where the cost of errors is high.
en.reason: OpenRouter tested Claude Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and Haiku 5.5 on 11 coding tasks: all passed, but costs varied 30x, so Sonnet 5.5 is the default, Haiku 5.5 suits frequent/subagent work, and Opus 5.5 long, high-error-cost tasks.

sources.title: Cursor 披露 Claude Code VS Code 扩展被植入恶意软件事件，最多影响 5000 用户 / We identified a security incident affecting a modified Claude Code VS Code extension accessed through our Cursor IDE extension marketplac...
sources.title_zh: Cursor 披露 Claude Code VS Code 扩展被植入恶意软件事件，最多影响 5000 用户
sources.title_en: We identified a security incident affecting a modified Claude Code VS Code extension accessed through our Cursor IDE extension marketplac...
sources.title_original: We identified a security incident affecting a modified Claude Code VS Code extension accessed through our Cursor IDE extension marketplac...
sources.summary: Cursor 发现通过其 IDE 扩展市场分发的 Claude Code VS Code 扩展被修改并植入恶意软件，最多影响 5000 用户，恶意版本并非 Anthropic 开发。Cursor 已于当日下午下线扩展市场，与相关提供方合作清除恶意软件并确认无进一步风险后重新上线，建议受影响用户参考博客说明排查，并升级到 Claude Code for VS Code 2.1.314。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Cursor IDE 扩展市场出现被篡改的 Claude Code VS Code 扩展，最多影响 5,000 名用户，该恶意版本并非 Anthropic 开发，也不波及市场内其他扩展。

en.summary: Cursor discovered that the Claude Code VS Code extension distributed through its IDE extension marketplace had been tampered with and implanted with malware, affecting up to 5,000 users; the malicious version was not developed by Anthropic. Cursor took the marketplace offline that afternoon and restored it after working with the relevant providers to remove the malware and confirm there was no further risk. Affected users should refer to the blog post to check their systems and upgrade to Claude Code for VS Code 2.1.314.
en.reason: A tampered Claude Code VS Code extension on Cursor's IDE marketplace carried malware, affected up to 5,000 users and was not developed by Anthropic; Cursor took the marketplace offline and urges upgrading to Claude Code for VS Code 2.1.314.

stories.title: Unsloth 发布 Mistral Le Chonk 1-bit GGUF 量化版，可本地运行 1T 参数模型 / Mistral Le Chonk can now run locally!

sources.title: Unsloth 发布 Mistral Le Chonk 1-bit GGUF 量化版，可本地运行 1T 参数模型 / Mistral Le Chonk can now run locally!
sources.title_zh: Unsloth 发布 Mistral Le Chonk 1-bit GGUF 量化版，可本地运行 1T 参数模型
sources.title_en: Mistral Le Chonk can now run locally!
sources.title_original: Mistral Le Chonk can now run locally!
sources.summary: Unsloth 发布 Mistral Le Chonk（Mistral Large 4，1T 参数 MoE，52B 激活）的 Dynamic 1-bit GGUF，可在 Mac Studio 上本地运行，保留 91% top-1 准确率，体积约 233GB（较 1.1TB FP8 小 80%）。图为各量化档位给出硬件需求，1-bit 需 256-270GB 内存，最小 UD-IQ1_S 约占 233GB 磁盘，并支持文本与图像输入、1M 上下文和 160+ 语言。GGUF 与指南见 huggingface.co/unsloth/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B-GGUF 和 unsloth.ai/docs/models/mistral-large-4。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Mistral Le Chonk 这个 1 万亿参数模型现在可通过 1-bit GGUF 在 Mac Studio 上本地运行，并保留 91% 的 top-1 准确率，号称迄今最强的西方开放模型。

en.summary: Unsloth has released a Dynamic 1-bit GGUF of Mistral Le Chonk (Mistral Large 4, a 1T-parameter MoE with 52B active), which can run locally on a Mac Studio, retains 91% top-1 accuracy, and is about 233GB (80% smaller than the 1.1TB FP8 version). A chart details hardware requirements by quantization tier: 1-bit needs 256–270GB of memory, while the smallest UD-IQ1_S takes about 233GB of disk. It supports text and image input, a 1M context window, and 160+ languages. The GGUF and guide are at huggingface.co/unsloth/Mistral-Large-4-1T-A52B-GGUF and unsloth.ai/docs/models/mistral-large-4.
en.reason: Unsloth's Dynamic 1-bit GGUF lets Mistral Le Chonk, a 1T-parameter MoE with 52B active parameters, run locally on a Mac Studio at roughly 233GB while retaining 91% top-1 accuracy.

sources.summary: 据《纽约时报》报道，美国情报机构认为英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋身边一名高管为中国提供情报，此人是新加坡数据中心运营商 Megaspeed 的 Alice Huang（黄乐）。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 据《The New York Times》报道，美国情报机构认为 Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang 身边的 Alice Huang（黄乐）向北京传递信息，她是新加坡数据中心运营商 Megaspeed 高管；其马来西亚姊妹公司曾在2024年6月至2026年2月间购入至少48亿美元含 Nvidia 芯片的 AI 硬件。

en.summary: According to The New York Times, U.S. intelligence agencies believe a senior executive in Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's orbit has been providing intelligence to China: Alice Huang (Huang Le) of Singapore data center operator Megaspeed.
en.reason: US intelligence agencies reportedly believe Alice Huang (Huang Le), an executive at Singapore-based data center operator Megaspeed linked to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's circle, passed information to Beijing, per The New York Times, while her Malaysian sister company allegedly bought at least $4.8 billion in Nvidia-chip AI hardware between June 2024 and February 2026.

items.summary: 据《纽约时报》报道，美国情报机构认为英伟达 CEO 黄仁勋身边一名高管为中国提供情报，此人是新加坡数据中心运营商 Megaspeed 的 Alice Huang（黄乐）。
items.recommend_reason_zh: 据《The New York Times》报道，美国情报机构认为 Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang 身边的 Alice Huang（黄乐）向北京传递信息，她是新加坡数据中心运营商 Megaspeed 高管；其马来西亚姊妹公司曾在2024年6月至2026年2月间购入至少48亿美元含 Nvidia 芯片的 AI 硬件。

en.summary: According to The New York Times, U.S. intelligence agencies believe a senior executive in Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's orbit has been providing intelligence to China: Alice Huang (Huang Le) of Singapore data center operator Megaspeed.
en.reason: US intelligence agencies reportedly believe Alice Huang (Huang Le), an executive at Singapore-based data center operator Megaspeed linked to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's circle, passed information to Beijing, per The New York Times, while her Malaysian sister company allegedly bought at least $4.8 billion in Nvidia-chip AI hardware between June 2024 and February 2026.

sources.title_original: Codex 宣布即日起 Pro 及 Business Premium 各档位用量上限翻倍
sources.summary: Tibo 宣布即日起将 Pro 100/200/500 档位与 Business Premium 的所有用量上限翻倍。Pro 200 的上限不会下调，Work 与 Codex 用量保持不变；dots 的扩展用量上限继续提供，且仍与默认用量分开计算，后续还会通过更好的模型和效率改进提升实际可用量。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Codex 宣布即日起将 Pro 100/200/500 全部档位及 Business Premium 的用量上限翻倍，并回应反馈不再下调 Pro 200，Work 与 Codex 用量维持不变。

en.title: Codex announces that, effective immediately, usage limits are doubled across all Pro and Business Premium tiers.
en.summary: Tibo announced that, effective immediately, all usage limits across the Pro 100/200/500 tiers and Business Premium are being doubled. The Pro 200 limit will not be reduced, and Work and Codex usage remain unchanged. dots' extended usage limits will continue to be available and are still counted separately from default usage, with future gains in actual usable capacity to come from better models and efficiency improvements.
en.reason: Codex immediately doubles all usage limits for the Pro 100, Pro 200 and Pro 500 tiers plus Business Premium, and reverses course on Pro 200 by keeping its cap unchanged while Work and Codex usage stay as is.

sources.summary: Wiz 基于自身事件响应与公开披露案例，分析 AI 智能体参与真实入侵的现状与趋势，涉及 ARTEX、Hermes 等框架及韩国金融机构（约 67,000 人信息外泄）、泰国财政部、ConnectWise 供应链（尝试攻击超 2,250 个租户）等案例。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Wiz 原文链接返回 404 Not Found，页面仅剩 Cookie 与隐私选项说明，标题承诺的 agentic attacks 内容并未加载。

en.summary: Wiz analyzes the current state and trajectory of AI agents in real-world intrusions based on its own incident response work and publicly disclosed cases, covering frameworks such as ARTEX and Hermes and incidents including a South Korean financial institution (data on about 67,000 people exposed), Thailand’s Ministry of Finance, and the ConnectWise supply chain (attempted attacks on more than 2,250 tenants).
en.reason: Wiz links AI agent frameworks ARTEX and Hermes to real intrusions, including a South Korean financial firm's leak of about 67,000 people's data, Thailand's Ministry of Finance and ConnectWise supply-chain attempts on over 2,250 tenants.

stories.title: 腾讯混元发布 Hy-Nomas 技术报告并开源 Hy-Nomas-Bench / Technical report of Hy-Nomas released last Friday: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36729

sources.title: 腾讯混元发布 Hy-Nomas 技术报告并开源 Hy-Nomas-Bench / Technical report of Hy-Nomas released last Friday: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36729
sources.title_zh: 腾讯混元发布 Hy-Nomas 技术报告并开源 Hy-Nomas-Bench
sources.title_en: Technical report of Hy-Nomas released last Friday: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36729
sources.title_original: Technical report of Hy-Nomas released last Friday: https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.36729
sources.summary: 腾讯混元发布 Hy-Nomas 开源交互式视频世界模型的技术报告（arXiv:2610.36729），并开源 Hy-Nomas-Bench 数据集用于可复现研究。官方还用 Hy-Nomas 重现 Genie 4 示例并放出对比视频，演示无需排队即可试用，地址为 https://hy-nomas.hy.tencent.com/。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Hy-Nomas 上周五发布技术报告（arXiv:2610.36729），并开源 Hy-Nomas-Bench 支持可复现研究，还用 Hy-Nomas 复现 Genie 4 示例并发布对比视频，邀请读者试用 demo。

en.summary: Tencent Hunyuan releases a technical report for Hy-Nomas, its open-source interactive video world model (arXiv:2610.36729), and open-sources the Hy-Nomas-Bench dataset for reproducible research. The team also recreated Genie 4 examples with Hy-Nomas and released comparison videos; the demo can be tried without a waitlist at https://hy-nomas.hy.tencent.com/.
en.reason: Tencent Hunyuan released the Hy-Nomas technical report (arXiv:2610.36729) last Friday, open-sourced the Hy-Nomas-Bench dataset for reproducible research, and reproduced Genie 4 examples with comparison videos and a demo available to try.

sources.title: Gemini 新增文档、PDF、演示文稿和表格的直接生成、预览与编辑功能 / You can now generate, preview, and edit documents, PDFs, presentations, spreadsheets, and more directly in Gemini.

sources.summary: Google Gemini 宣布可直接在应用内生成、预览和编辑文档、PDF、演示文稿、表格等多种文件。支持把手写笔记转成 PDF 学习指南、手动调整内容、高亮部分让 Gemini 修改文字或视觉元素，并可继续追问。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Gemini 现在可以直接生成、预览并编辑文档、PDF、演示文稿和表格，还能把手写笔记一键变成 PDF 学习指南，并可圈选段落让 Gemini 修改文字或画面、继续追问。

en.summary: Google Gemini now lets you generate, preview, and edit documents, PDFs, presentations, spreadsheets, and other files directly in the app. It can turn handwritten notes into PDF study guides, let you manually adjust content, highlight sections for Gemini to revise text or visual elements, and continue asking follow-up questions.
en.reason: Google Gemini now generates, previews and edits documents, PDFs, presentations and spreadsheets in-app, can turn handwritten notes into a PDF study guide, and lets users highlight sections for Gemini to revise text or visuals.

stories.title: Figma 讲解如何训练专用画布编辑模型 / How we’re training a Figma-fluent editing model

sources.title: Figma 讲解如何训练专用画布编辑模型 / How we’re training a Figma-fluent editing model
sources.title_zh: Figma 讲解如何训练专用画布编辑模型
sources.title_en: How we’re training a Figma-fluent editing model
sources.title_original: How we’re training a Figma-fluent editing model
sources.summary: Figma 介绍其为 agent 自研 Figma 编辑模型的训练方法，先用超过 25 万条合成样本做 SFT，让早期 Llama 3.3 70B 在编辑任务上接近当时顶级模型，后转向 RL 并结合确定性校验器与视觉评委做评测。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Figma 披露其设计编辑模型训练路径：先以 SFT 在超过 25 万示例上训练 Llama 3.3 70B，使其在当时编辑任务中可比顶尖模型，如今正加入 RL 提升泛化。

en.summary: Figma detailed how it trained its in-house Figma editing model for agents: it first used SFT on more than 250,000 synthetic samples, bringing an early Llama 3.3 70B close to the top models of the time on editing tasks, then shifted to RL and combined deterministic verifiers with a visual judge for evaluation.
en.reason: Figma trained an early Llama 3.3 70B on more than 250,000 synthetic examples via SFT to bring its design-editing tasks close to top models of the time, and now adds reinforcement learning with deterministic checkers and a vision judge for evaluation.

sources.title: 超节点火了一年后，“算力不够就加机器”的扩张逻辑正在被改写
sources.title_zh: 超节点火了一年后，“算力不够就加机器”的扩张逻辑正在被改写
sources.title_original: 超节点火了一年后，“算力不够就加机器”的扩张逻辑正在被改写
sources.summary:
超节点真正试图解决的，恰恰是过去那种依靠增加机器数量扩充算力的方式所暴露的问题。
超节点真正试图解决的，恰恰是过去那种依靠增加机器数量扩充算力的方式所暴露的问题。
本文字数：5386 字
阅读完需：约 18 分钟
超节点正成为AI算力基础设施新焦点，其核心是通过紧耦合互联与软硬协同，将数百至上千颗AI芯片整合为高效统一的计算单元。
超节点直面大模型训练中数据搬运、跨芯片同步与内存利用率低等关键瓶颈；NVLink/CXL等高带宽互连是实现低时延通信的基础；软硬协同设计决定实际性能增益是否匹配硬件规模扩张。
适合AI基础设施工程师、大模型系统架构师、高性能计算平台开发者阅读。
几十卡、数百卡、上千卡，AI 算力基础设施的规模竞赛，正在进入一个新的阶段。
过去，大模型厂商展示算力实力，最直观的方式是拥有多少张 GPU、建设了多大规模的计算集群。如今，随着超节点成为 AI 基础设施领域的热门方向，厂商展示实力的方式又多了一个：能够把多少颗 AI 芯片连接起来，让它们像一台计算机一样协同工作。
从英伟达的 GB200 NVL72，到华为的数百卡、千卡级超节点，再到各家国产厂商陆续推出的紧耦合计算
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 华为1024卡Atlas 950 SuperPoD、浪潮元脑SD200 Ultra跑Kimi K3达170 Tokens/s，文章追问超节点卡数竞赛能否换来实际模型性能。

en.title: A year after supernodes took off, the "if compute runs short, just add more machines" expansion playbook is being rewritten
en.summary:
What super nodes are really trying to solve is exactly the problem exposed by the old approach of scaling compute by adding more machines.

This article: 5,386 characters; reading time: about 18 minutes.

Super nodes are becoming a new focal point in AI compute infrastructure. At their core, tightly coupled interconnect and hardware-software co-design integrate hundreds to thousands of AI chips into a highly efficient, unified compute unit.

Super nodes directly confront key bottlenecks in large-model training — data movement, cross-chip synchronization, and low memory utilization. High-bandwidth interconnects such as NVLink/CXL are the foundation for low-latency communication; hardware-software co-design determines whether real performance gains keep pace with hardware scale-out.

Intended for AI infrastructure engineers, large-model system architects, and high-performance computing platform developers.

The scale race in AI compute infrastructure — from tens of cards to hundreds to thousands — is entering a new phase.

In the past, large-model vendors showed off their compute strength most directly through how many GPUs they owned and how large a compute cluster they had built. Now, as super nodes become a hot direction in AI infrastructure, vendors have another way to demonstrate their strength: how many AI chips they can connect so they work together like a single computer.

From NVIDIA's GB200 NVL72 to Huawei's hundreds-of-cards and thousand-card-class super nodes, and on to the tightly coupled computing systems rolled out one after another by domestic vendors…
en.reason: Supernode design now spans Nvidia's GB200 NVL72, Huawei's 1024-card Atlas 950 SuperPoD and Inspur's Yuanbrain SD200 Ultra hitting 170 Tokens/s on Kimi K3, and the piece asks whether piling on more cards actually delivers real model performance.

en.title: 2026 AI Technology Evolution and 2027 Trends Outlook Report
en.summary:
2026 AI Technology Evolution and 2027 Trends Outlook Report

In 2026, the AI industry moved from "capability showcase" to "value realization." This year, Agent engineering replaced model integration as the main battleground, as agents were deployed at scale and subjected to production-environment scrutiny, and enterprises shifted their key metric from "call volume" to "return on investment.
en.reason: 2026 marked AI's shift from capability demos to value delivery, as Agent engineering replaced model integration as the main battleground and enterprise metrics moved from API call volume to return on investment, with the report also looking ahead to 2027.

stories.title: AI+社区：「模力工场」连接AI供需，补上信任缺口｜极客邦科技创始人兼CEO 霍太稳分享

sources.title: AI+社区：「模力工场」连接AI供需，补上信任缺口｜极客邦科技创始人兼CEO 霍太稳分享
sources.title_zh: AI+社区：「模力工场」连接AI供需，补上信任缺口｜极客邦科技创始人兼CEO 霍太稳分享
sources.title_original: AI+社区：「模力工场」连接AI供需，补上信任缺口｜极客邦科技创始人兼CEO 霍太稳分享
sources.summary:
本文字数：4254 字
阅读完需：约 14 分钟
极客邦科技以模力工场为载体，构建AI落地协同平台，聚焦企业与技术团队间匹配难、信任难、交付难的生态断点。
解决AI项目预算与周期预估不透明问题；建立基于历史交付表现的技术团队推荐机制；提供从匹配到交付评估的全链路协作支持。
适合AI解决方案架构师、企业数字化负责人、AI原生应用创业团队阅读。
极客邦科技创始人兼 CEO 霍太稳，为 1024 模力工场·AI 社区日的主论坛开场致辞，并以《AI 破局的生态法则：从零和博弈到共生智能》为题作主题分享。
霍太稳在开场致辞中表示，举办此次社区日、推动总部落地杭州，是希望立足本地，通过持续的社区建设与交流合作，为 AI 应用落地培育生态。
在主题分享中，他提出，AI 行业的关注点，正从大模型的参数竞争转向智能体及具体业务应用，于此同时，企业的需求正在变化：相比几天的培训，它们更希望服务方带着团队做出能用的智能体与 Skill，让学习直接连接实践。所以极客邦科技，也将“助力企业 AI 加速落地”作为业务升级的重要方向。
霍太稳表示，会用 AI 工具，不等于能用它解决业务问题。企业有需求、有预算，却不
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 霍太稳在1024模力工场·AI社区日分享，介绍模力工场用AI预估项目时间与预算、按历史交付表现推荐技术团队，试图补上企业找靠谱AI交付方与技术团队担心收款之间的信任缺口。

en.summary:
Word count: 4,254
Reading time: about 14 minutes

Geekbang Technology is using Moli Gongchang as the vehicle for an AI implementation collaboration platform, targeting the ecosystem gaps that make matching, trust and delivery so hard between enterprises and technical teams.

It tackles opaque budget and timeline estimates for AI projects; builds a recommendation mechanism for technical teams based on historical delivery performance; and provides end-to-end collaboration support from matching through delivery evaluation.

Intended for AI solution architects, enterprise digital transformation leaders and founders of AI-native application startups.

Geekbang Technology founder and CEO Huo Taiwen opened the main forum of the 1024 Moli Gongchang AI Community Day and delivered a keynote titled "The Ecosystem Rules of AI Breakthroughs: From Zero-Sum Games to Symbiotic Intelligence."

In his opening remarks, Huo said the community day, and the decision to base its headquarters in Hangzhou, are about rooting the company locally and cultivating an ecosystem for AI application deployment through sustained community building and exchange.

In the keynote, he argued that the AI industry's focus is shifting from parameter competition among large models to agents and concrete business applications, and that enterprise needs are changing with it: rather than a few days of training, companies want service providers to work alongside their teams to build usable agents and Skills, linking learning directly to practice. That is why Geekbang Technology has made "helping enterprises accelerate AI deployment" a key direction of its business upgrade.

Huo said that knowing how to use AI tools does not mean being able to use them to solve business problems. Enterprises have needs and budgets, yet

sources.title: 谷歌推出 EnvHarness，支持自进化智能体动态环境学习
sources.title_zh: 谷歌推出 EnvHarness，支持自进化智能体动态环境学习
sources.title_original: 谷歌推出 EnvHarness，支持自进化智能体动态环境学习
sources.summary:
谷歌研究人员开源 EnvHarness 框架，它可依据智能体短板动态调整训练环境，且不用改动智能体、环境与评估系统。
谷歌研究人员开源 EnvHarness 框架，它可依据智能体短板动态调整训练环境，且不用改动智能体、环境与评估系统。
本文字数：1130 字
阅读完需：约 4 分钟
EnvHarness 是谷歌开源的轻量级环境适配框架，通过可插拔组件动态变异静态环境行为，无需修改智能体、底层环境或评估逻辑。其核心创新在于将环境调整权从人工预设转向按智能体能力短板实时响应。
支持 setup/rule/link 三类接口定制初始状态、转移约束与观测呈现；仅封装标准 reset/step 接口，零侵入集成现有环境；变异策略与智能体训练解耦，避免环境生成依赖昂贵验证器。
适合AI系统工程师、强化学习平台开发者、智能体架构师阅读。

研究人员表示，自我进化型智能体通常通过重写提示词和获取新

en.title: Google launches EnvHarness to support dynamic environment learning for self-evolving agents
en.summary:
Google researchers have open-sourced EnvHarness, a framework that dynamically adjusts an agent's training environment based on its weaknesses — without modifying the agent, the environment, or the evaluation system.

Word count: 1,130 words. Reading time: about 4 minutes.

EnvHarness is a lightweight environment adaptation framework open-sourced by Google. Through pluggable components, it dynamically mutates static environment behavior without modifying the agent, the underlying environment, or the evaluation logic. Its core innovation is shifting control over environment adjustments from manual presets to real-time responses to an agent's capability gaps.

It supports three types of interfaces — setup/rule/link — for customizing initial state, transition constraints, and observation presentation. It wraps only the standard reset/step interfaces, integrating with existing environments with zero intrusion. Mutation strategies are decoupled from agent training, avoiding reliance on expensive verifiers for environment generation.

Suited for AI systems engineers, reinforcement learning platform developers, and agent architects.

Google researchers have open-sourced EnvHarness, a framework that can dynamically adjust an agent's training environment according to its weaknesses, without modifying the agent, environment, or evaluation system. The researchers say the approach improves both learning effectiveness and efficiency while helping agents overcome their own flaws.

The researchers say self-evolving agents typically rewrite prompts and acquire new
en.reason: Google researchers open-sourced EnvHarness, a lightweight framework that dynamically mutates static training environments via setup/rule/link interfaces without modifying the agent, environment or evaluation logic, lifting multiple models by 2.9 to 3.7 points on benchmarks such as WebArena.

sources.title_en: Microsoft’s AI future has fewer jobs
sources.title_original: Microsoft’s AI future has fewer jobs
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章披露Microsoft向US、UK、Canada、India约6万名员工提供自愿买断，此前刚裁4,800人、总员工降至约223,000，并用Satya Nadella“人均成本上升、每位研究员GPU增加”的话解析AI如何重塑用工规模。

en.reason: Microsoft offered voluntary buyouts to about 60,000 US, UK, Canada and India employees after cutting 4,800 jobs and reducing headcount to roughly 223,000, as Satya Nadella cited rising per-capita costs and more GPUs per researcher.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 3万字长文从Prefill/Decode访存差异讲到KVCache的O(N)瓶颈，并沿DeltaNet、GDN到KDA梳理线性注意力的Chunk-wise并行。

en.title: AI Infra Deep Dive: Understanding Linear Attention Mechanisms in 30,000 Words
en.summary: This article takes a deep dive into the evolution of linear attention from DeltaNet and GDN to KDA, then grounds it in the cache engineering behind hybrid models in vLLM, helping you understand the hardware-software trade-offs between model architecture and inference scheduling.
en.reason: Linear attention's evolution from DeltaNet and GDN to KDA is traced across a 30,000-character analysis that starts with Prefill/Decode memory-access differences and the O(N) KV Cache bottleneck, then lands in vLLM's Hybrid model cache implementation and Chunk-wise parallelism.

sources.title_original: Backdoors in official Claude Code extensions
sources.summary:
Anthropic got compromised. 

Their Claude Code extension on Visual Studio Code and Cursor has malware in it, which creates a remote access Trojan to desktops.  

https://phorion.io/blog/offical-claude-code-vsx-compromise/
Anthropic got compromised. 

Their Claude Code extension on Visual Studio Code and Cursor has malware in it, which creates a remote access Trojan to desktops.  

https://phorion.io/blog/offical-claude-code-vsx-compromise/
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Anthropic 遭入侵，其 Claude Code 在 Visual Studio Code 和 Cursor 上的官方扩展被植入恶意代码，会创建远程访问木马控制用户桌面，文中附 phorion.io 的分析链接。

en.reason: Anthropic's official Claude Code extension for Visual Studio Code and Cursor was compromised with malicious code that creates a remote access Trojan to control users' desktops, according to analysis linked at phorion.io.

en.title: Grace Blackwell needs a new scheduler: 27% more GPUs available in the same rack
en.reason: NVL72 links 72 rack GPUs over NVLink, but cross-rack traffic still uses InfiniBand and runs 43% slower; SkyPilot’s topology-aware placement, in-place GPU-failure recovery and automatic defragmentation keep multi-node training and inference rack-local.
